issues.issue: Did the RPD err by failing to assess the sur place claim based on threats from Laszlo Fustos?
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored the sur place risk from threats by Fustos, a man allegedly linked to a criminal organization in Hungary.
issues.result_quote: However it is clear that the RPD did not deal with this part of the claim in its decision. This constitutes an error of law.
